paragraphs: The Fire Lancer combines a soldier's pole weapon with the sudden burst of a short-range firearm. In Age of Empires, this armored shock infantry opens with gunpowder before closing to fight at close quarters.
This army fields the Korean version, testing how its unusual combination performs against the other civilizations' troops.
The Elite Fire Lancer fires its charged shot as the enemy approaches, then fights in melee while the weapon recharges. That opening burst gives its attacks a different rhythm from ordinary infantry.
It is strong against cavalry and buildings, but militia-line infantry and archers can exploit its weaknesses. Closing the distance is a crucial part of the battle.
